profile.headline: Staff Software Engineer at Apple
profile.summary: Software engineer that enjoys solving challenging problems and working as an integral member of a team. Extensive experience developing web services for asset management systems using a variety of tools and languages including C#, WCF, and SQL Server.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Develop .NET (C#) client/server media asset management system communicating using RESTful services and leveraging a SQL database backend
- Develop and maintain RESTful API used by internal and external consumers
- Create unit tests, load tests, and automated tests using NUnit, FlaUI, and Microsoft Load Testing tools
- Practice Scrum/agile methodologies for planning and executing work
- Use JIRA for tracking sprints, user stories, and bugs
- Write and fill in detail for user stories that will become software features and enhancements
- Work on continuous integration using Jenkins

Team Lead
- Mentor, guide, and remove impediments for a team of software and QA engineers 
- Help the team achieve their goals and objectives and grow as engineers
- First point of contact for resolving issues within the team and answering questions

Scrum Master
- Practice Scrum agile development
- Work closely with teams across the globe to develop shared features
- Facilitate the Scrum process for development team 
- Set up and run various scrum ceremonies and sizing sessions
- Compile sprint reports and lead retrospective meetings
- Create dashboards, queries, and metrics to provide data and feedback to the team using JIRA, Confluence, and Klipfolio

MECOP mentor and and board member stand in
- Mentor MECOP interns and make sure they have the tools and knowledge they need to get their work done
- Evaluate interns and provide them with performance feedback including areas of strength and areas needing work
- Attend MECOP events such as member meetings and career fairs and talk with MECOP students

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Worked on client/server asset management systems communicating using RESTful services.
- Developed in C# using Visual Studio
- Created and maintained RESTful APIs
- Ran Load Tests using Microsoft's load testing tools in VS Ultimate
- Wrote procedures and scripts for storing/retrieving data from a SQL Server database
- Created unit tests and other automated tests

positions.title: Software Development Engineer In Test
positions.description:
Worked on QA testing video server hardware
- Configured hardware in a lab environment to run various tests
- Updated complex, multi-component systems to newer versions of software as it was built
- Followed test cases and submitted any bugs found to various bug tracking systems

Writing UI automation tests for an asset management application.
- Developed automation framework in C# using TestStack.White and Windows UI Automation.
- Created tests using the framework for different components of the application
- Maintained automation framework and tests to keep up with rapidly developing application
- Ran tests and submitted bugs to current bug tracking system

volunteerExperiences.description: Worked to sort and package donated food so that it can be easier distributed to places that need it.

projects.title: Grass Valley STRATUS
projects.description: The Grass Valley STRATUS media workflow application framework is a highly versatile non-linear production solution, combining production tools, device control, and asset control into intuitive, and highly configurable multi-tasking user interfaces within a single unified application.
